description: Earth Rotation Angle, Greenwich mean sidereal time and the polar motion and terrestrial rotation matrices from ERFA, for UTC dates on the 15th of February, May, August and November from 1973, at spread times of day. Each case carries the UT1-UTC (s) and pole coordinates (") of the C04 series on that day, which the test hands to the gem, so both sides start from the same UT1 and only the formulas are compared. UT1 is UTC + UT1-UTC and TT is UTC + TAI-UTC + 32.184 s, as two-part Julian Dates. era00 and gmst06 are in radians. pom00 is the polar motion matrix W including the TIO locator s' from sp00, in ERFA's sense V(TRS) = W V(CIP). c2tcio is ERFA's celestial-to-terrestrial matrix with the CIRS as the celestial frame, W R3(ERA).

source.method: era00(2400000.5, mjd + ut1_utc / 86400); gmst06(ut1, taitt(utctai(2400000.5, mjd))); pom00(x, y, sp00(tt)); c2tcio(identity, era, pom)
